Private reassembly state with pool, maps, queues, and slot-to-block tracking.

# Purpose
This header defines the private data layout and container types used by the `fd_reasm` reassembly code. It includes template-based pool, map, list, and deque implementations to manage `fd_reasm_fec_t` objects and related indexes such as `ancestry`, `frontier`, `orphaned`, and `subtrees`. The `slot_mr_t` type and `slot_mr` map store the relation between a slot number and a block hash. The `fd_reasm` structure then groups all internal state needed for tree tracking, breadth-first traversal, output delivery, and slot-to-message lookup.
